title: Serenissima – La Dolce Vita above Paradise Valley
description:
Masterfully conceived and designed by esteemed Paradise Valley real estate developer Shomo Das, Serenissima—Italian for “Most Serene”—is a breathtaking modern Mediterranean sanctuary perched atop the hills of Paradise Valley.

Welcome to Serenissima—your private hillside retreat in the heart of Paradise Valley. This recently remodeled 6-bedroom, 6-bathroom estate blends modern Mediterranean elegance with unmatched tranquility and sweeping views of Camelback and Mummy Mountains.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Exercise equipment: free weights, yoga mat
